title: Coast Guard rescue swimmer lowered to assist man rescued from capsized vessel outside Columbia River Bar entrance
description: Chief Petty Officer Joel M. Sayers, an aviation survival technician from Coast Guard Air Station Astoria, Ore., is lowered from an MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter onto the deck of a 47-foot Motor Life Boat outside the Columbia River Bar entrance, June 20, 2014. Sayers was lowered to assist the MLB crew from Coast Guard Station Cape Disappointment in their efforts to resuscitate a man who was rescued from a capsized vessel. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Astoria.
